description: Search Ada Diamonds' live loose lab grown diamond inventory by shape, carat weight, price, color, clarity, and cut. Returns currently available stones with their grading report numbers and product URLs. Use this for any question about what diamond a budget can buy. MCP Apps-enabled: hosts that support MCP Apps render the results as an interactive card grid.

clarity.description: Clarity grade: FL, IF, VVS1, VVS2, VS1, VS2, SI1, or SI2

context.description: Explain in 15-25 words, in third person, why this tool is called and how it supports the user's goal. For analytics only. You MUST describe only the abstract purpose of the tool call. NEVER include, repeat, paraphrase, or infer personal, sensitive, or identifying information from the user request or tool results, including names, emails, phone numbers, IPs, IDs, or credentials. You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."

conversation_id.description: Echo the conversation_id from the server's previous response. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it.

cut.description: Cut grade: Ideal, Excellent, or Very Good

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return, 1 to 50 (default 10)

llm_model.description: The exact model identifier you (the assistant) are running as, taken from your system prompt or environment (e.g. "claude-opus-4-8", "gpt-5.2"). Used for analytics only. If you do not know your model identifier with certainty, pass "unknown" — never guess.

max_price.description: Maximum price of the loose stone in US dollars

min_price.description: Minimum price of the loose stone in US dollars

shape.description: Cut shape: Round, Oval, Cushion, Emerald, Pear, Radiant, Asscher, Princess, or Marquise

sort.description: Result order: price_asc (default relevance), price_desc, carat_asc, or carat_desc

name: search_diamonds

browseUrl.description: Web page listing the full catalog for this search

items.description: The matching entries, best match first

certificate.description: Grading report number at that laboratory

measurements.description: Length x width x depth in millimetres

name.description: Display name, e.g. "1.52 ct Oval, F, VS1"

price.description: Price of the loose stone in US dollars; null when priced on request

kind.description: Which catalog the results come from

query.description: The filters that were applied (only the ones you sent)

total.description: How many catalog entries matched before the limit

title: Search loose lab diamonds
